service.name: Live music and a DJ for a Halloween party
service.serviceType: A DJ, a party band or live band karaoke for adult Halloween parties at home and at venues
service.description: A DJ, a party band or live band karaoke for an adult Halloween party across Denver and the Front Range, at home or at a venue: a DJ in 6 by 4 feet playing the songs a costume crowd wants, a trio or quartet playing the hits to a floor, or the band that plays the 80s and 90s hits and hands the microphone to anyone in costume, with sound support sized to the house and one personal contact for the night.

faqs.q: Do you have a DJ for a Halloween party?
faqs.a: Yes. A DJ is the usual first question for a Halloween party and the easiest one for a house, with a set built around the decade your guests grew up in. It's one contract with sound support sized to the house, booked through Signet Artists in Denver, and the same DJ can take the late end of a night after a band.

faqs.q: Will the band or the DJ play in costume?
faqs.a: Ask us with the booking. The musicians decide what they wear, and a themed set, the songs that belong to the night, is a request we take with the date.

faqs.q: How loud is it, and how late can it run?
faqs.a: It's a party, so once the floor fills it plays like one. The loud part of any home party belongs indoors once the neighbors have gone to bed, which is why the floor for this one is usually a finished basement, a garage with the cars out, or the main floor with the doors shut. If your street or HOA has quiet hours in writing, give them to us at contract and the night gets built under them.

faqs.q: How much space does a Halloween party band need?
faqs.a: A DJ takes about 6 by 4 feet on one dedicated circuit and 45 minutes to set up, a trio 12 by 8 on one, and a quartet or the karaoke four-piece 14 by 10 on two, and none of them want to share a circuit with the fog machine and the string lights. On a night when every house on the block has guests, tell us about the driveway or the alley and which door is ours. Sets run 45 to 60 minutes with music through the breaks.
